commands_file.label: Commands file
commands_file.description: JSON file with commands [{name, prompt}]. Empty = built-in.

clear_session.label: Clear session before each request
clear_session.description: Off: one persistent Hermes session (context persists). On: session history is deleted before each request via DELETE /api/sessions/ai-menu (no new sessions are created).

chat_command.label: Chat command
chat_command.description: Terminal command for the Chat button. {session} is replaced with the session id. For Docker: docker exec -it hermes-agent hermes chat --resume {session}

language.label: Language
language.description: Plugin UI and command prompts language.

ui.title: AI Menu
ui.ask_hint: Type your question (Enter to send, Esc to go back)
ui.no_selection: Select some text and open the menu
